_doc: MINIMAL, COPYABLE lesson-substrate example (ADR-080 / agent-memory-lesson-substrate). This is the SMALLEST agentic flow that both EMITS lessons (emit_lesson tool) and RECEIVES them (automatic brief-assembly injection). It is a STARTING TEMPLATE, deliberately trimmed of the ops-agent's full observation toolset — copy it, rename the platform/role, point the model endpoint at your LLM, and add your own tools. See docs/concepts/32-agent-memory.md#worked-example for the runnable walkthrough and configs/rules/lessons/README.md for the promotion/retirement rulepack. Every tool name, predicate, and $entity reference here is grep-verified against the shipped vocab/registry.
_emit_side: The single role below carries emit_lesson in agentic-tools.allowed_tools. When a finished loop reveals durable guidance, the agent calls emit_lesson (summary/detail/injection_form/category/polarity/severity/evidence_entity_ids/applies_to). The lesson is born status=proposed and is NOT injected until an operator/product promotes it to active (LessonCurator.Promote — evidence-existence gated; there is NO promote_lesson agent tool).
_receive_side: Brief assembly derives this loop's scope from its role as tag:<default_role> (processor/agentic-loop/lessons.go deriveLoopScope). Any ACTIVE lesson whose agent.lesson.applies-to includes that tag is rendered verbatim into the system prompt — no tool call. So a lesson this role should receive must cite applies_to: "tag:lesson-example" (matching default_role below). Promote the emitted lesson and the NEXT loop of this role sees it.
_persona_note: The emit contract that teaches the agent HOW to call emit_lesson lives in a persona fragment: configs/personas/fragments/lesson-example/00-identity.md (role dir name == default_role). It is loaded at boot by persona.LoadFromDirectory. The inline snippet is reproduced there; edit the .md, not this file, to change persona guidance (files in git are the source of truth; runtime update_persona edits are ephemeral). deriveLoopScope uses the loop's role, not the persona, so injection works even before you write a persona.
_prereqs: To RUN this (not just --validate): a reachable NATS at nats.urls and an LLM endpoint at model_registry.endpoints.general.url (or a mock). The AGENT and TOOL streams are auto-derived from the jetstream OUTPUT ports below (config/streams.go EnsureStreams); the USER stream is declared explicitly under streams because it is an INPUT-only subject and is not derived from any output port.

model_registry._doc: Swap url/model for your real LLM endpoint (OpenAI-compatible). Left concrete so --validate passes; not dialed until the flow actually runs.

server_info.title: SemStreams Lesson Example
server_info.description: Minimal ADR-080 lesson emit + receive template. GET /graph/triples?predicate=agent.lesson.status to inspect emitted lessons.

agentic-dispatch._doc: Routes user.message -> agent.task. default_role stamps every dispatched loop with role=lesson-example; brief assembly turns that into the tag:lesson-example scope used to match active lessons for injection.
agentic-dispatch.name: agentic-dispatch

agentic-loop._doc: The loop orchestrator. At dispatch it assembles the brief, injecting active lessons whose applies-to matches this loop's tag:lesson-example scope (SetLessonReader wiring). No lesson-specific config is required here — injection is on by default when the loop has a role.
agentic-loop.name: agentic-loop

agentic-tools._doc: The tool executor. allowed_tools is deliberately MINIMAL: just emit_lesson (distil a lesson). emit_lesson returns StopLoop:false, so after emitting its lesson(s) the loop ends by NATURAL terminal-tool-less completion — the model returns a text-only response with no further tool call. There is no submit_work terminator (submit_work is NOT a registered executor and would 404 if called). A real emitter that gathers its own evidence would also add read_loop_result and query_entity so the agent can cite real 6-part evidence entity IDs; kept out here to stay minimal. Add your product's work tools alongside emit_lesson.
agentic-tools._emit_contract: emit_lesson gates (rejected with an instructive error, never truncated): (1) >=1 well-formed 6-part evidence_entity_ids; (2) injection_form <= 320 bytes; (3) >=1 typed applies_to key (id:<prefix of 3+ segments> or tag:<token>); (4) per-loop cap (default 20). polarity is avoid|best_practice (rejected on mismatch); severity is info|warning|critical (clamped to info). Do NOT pass identity fields — loop/role attribution is derived by the framework.
agentic-tools.name: agentic-tools

graph-ingest._doc: Writes ENTITY_STATES. emit_lesson creates each lesson through graph.mutation.entity.create; LessonCurator.Promote/Retire/Supersede reconcile agent.lesson.status through graph.mutation.entity.reconcile. Required for any lesson to persist or be queryable via GET /graph/triples.
graph-ingest.name: graph-ingest
